blocks.text: Qizil kitobda go to **work**, at **school**, in **bed**, go **home** kabi artiklsiz iboralarni ko'rgan edik (→ qizil kitob, 71-dars). Endi ularning mantig'ini chuqurroq ko'ramiz. **school**, **university**, **hospital**, **prison**, **church** — har biri muayyan maqsad uchun qurilgan muassasa: o'qish, davolanish, jazo, ibodat. Odam u yerga **aynan shu maqsad bilan** borsa (o'quvchi, talaba, bemor, mahbus, ibodat qiluvchi sifatida) — artikl **yo'q**: gap bino haqida emas, faoliyat haqida. Boshqa har qanday holatda — bino, joy yoki boshqa maqsad — oddiy qoida ishlaydi: **the** yoki **a**.

blocks.text: O'zbekchada ham bu farq bor, faqat u fe'l bilan ifodalanadi: «kasalxonaga **yotdi**» (bemor) — «kasalxonaga **bordi**» (ko'rgani); «**qamaldi**» — «qamoqxonaga bordi»; «maktabga **chiqdi**» (o'quvchi bo'ldi) — «maktabga bordi». Inglizchada fe'l bir xil bo'lishi mumkin (go to), farqni artikl ko'rsatadi.

items.text: Our son is still at **school**, so he can't work full-time.
items.translation: O'g'limiz hali **maktabda o'qiydi**, shuning uchun to'liq ishlay olmaydi.

items.text: She was in **hospital** for a week after the operation.
items.translation: Operatsiyadan keyin u bir hafta **kasalxonada yotdi**.

blocks.text: O'qituvchi, hamshira, qorovul yoki ota-ona uchun bu muassasa — **ish joyi yoki tashrif joyi**, ya'ni bino. Shuning uchun: Madina works at **the hospital**; We went to **the hospital** to visit Grandpa. Bitta gapda ikkalasi ham kelishi mumkin: Grandpa is **in hospital**, so we're going to **the hospital**. Farqni yodda tuting: She's **in hospital** — u bemor; She's **at the hospital** — u o'sha yerda (ishlaydi, kimnidir ko'rgani borgan yoki tekshiruvga kelgan).

items.text: Grandma is **in hospital**, so we're going to **the hospital** to see her.
items.translation: Buvim **kasalxonada yotibdi**, shuning uchun uni ko'rgani **kasalxonaga** boryapmiz.

items.text: Jasur works as a guard at **the prison**.
The meeting for parents is in **the school** hall at six.

blocks.text: Artiklsiz shakl faqat **yalang'och** iborada ishlaydi: go to school, be in hospital. Otga sifat yoki aniqlovchi qo'shilib, u **muayyan muassasaga** aylansa, artikl qaytadi: She goes to **a private school**. He was sent to **a prison** in the north. This is **the hospital** where I was born. Egalik va ko'rsatish so'zlari ham shunday: **my** old school, **this** university, **which** university? Taqqoslang: My cousin wants to go to **university** (talaba bo'lmoqchi) — but she doesn't know **which university** (qaysi biri).

items.text: She goes to **a very strict school**.
He was sent to **a prison** near the border.
This is **the hospital** where I was born.

blocks.text: Faoliyat iboralari: bed, work, home, class, court, town, sea

Xuddi shu mantiq boshqa so'zlarda ham bor: artiklsiz ibora — **faoliyat yoki holat**, artikl bilan — **narsa, joy yoki aniq vazifa**. Ulardan ba'zilari B1 darajada yangi: **in class** (dars paytida), **go to court** (sudga murojaat qilmoq), **go into town** (o'z shahrimiz markaziga bormoq — qaysi shahar ekani aniq), **go to sea** (dengizchi bo'lmoq), **at sea** (kemada, dengizda suzayotgan).

go to **work**, at **work**, start / finish / leave **work**

items.text: Their ship was **at sea** for two months.

blocks.text: home — eng ko'p xato qilinadigan so'z

**home** harakat fe'llaridan keyin na **to**, na artikl oladi: go **home**, come **home**, get **home**, on my way **home**. O'rin — **at home**: stay **at home**, work from **home**. Ikki nozik farq bor. Birinchisi: **leave home** — ota-ona uyidan butunlay ketib, mustaqil yashay boshlash; **leave the house** — shunchaki uydan chiqish (ishga, do'konga). Ikkinchisi: boshqa odamning uyi haqida — **Aziz's house**, **my parents' house** (go to Aziz's house), sifat bilan esa — **a lovely home**. **Make yourself at home** — «O'z uyingizdagidek bo'ling».

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «My son goes to the school» (o'quvchi sifatida) → **goes to school**; «She is in the hospital» (bemor, British English) → **in hospital**; «He went to the prison for five years» → **went to prison**; «I went to hospital to visit my friend» → **to the hospital** (o'zingiz bemor emassiz); «He studies at university of Oxford» → **at the University of Oxford** (nom — 78-dars); «go to home» → **go home**; «I left home at 8 to catch the bus» → **I left the house** (leave home — ota-ona uyidan butunlay ketish).

O'zingizdan so'rang: «Bu odam u yerga muassasaning **asosiy vazifasi** uchun boryaptimi?» O'quvchi — maktabga, bemor — kasalxonaga, mahbus — qamoqqa, ibodat qiluvchi — cherkovga: artikl yo'q. Boshqa har qanday odam (ota-ona, mehmon, xodim, sayyoh) yoki binoning o'zi — **the**. Sifat yoki aniqlovchi qo'shilsa — **a / the** qaytadi.

British va American English: Britaniyada **in hospital**, **at university**, **go to university**; Amerikada **in the hospital**, **in college**, **go to college**. Nomli oliygohlar (Oxford University, the University of Oxford) — 78-dars; transport (by bus, on foot) — qizil kitob, 71-dars; the sea, the mountains — 73-dars.

examples.title: **school** / **the school**, **university** / **the university**
examples.description: Artiklsiz — o'quvchi yoki talaba sifatida (o'qish uchun); the bilan — bino yoki boshqa maqsad (ota-ona majlisi, konsert, ta'mir).

sentences.text: Our daughter starts **school** in September, and she's already very excited.
sentences.translation: Qizimiz sentabrda **maktabga chiqadi**, hozirdanoq juda hayajonda.

sentences.text: What do you want to do after you leave **school**?
sentences.translation: **Maktabni** bitirgandan keyin nima qilmoqchisan?

sentences.text: The children aren't at **school** today because of the heavy snow.
sentences.translation: Kuchli qor tufayli bolalar bugun **maktabga borishmadi**.

sentences.text: My mum went to **the school** to talk to my maths teacher.
sentences.translation: Onam matematika o'qituvchim bilan gaplashgani **maktabga** bordi.

sentences.text: Bekzod went to **university** in Moscow, but now he works in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Moskvada **oliygohda o'qigan**, hozir esa Toshkentda ishlaydi.

sentences.text: There's a free concert at **the university** tonight — shall we go?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **universitetda** bepul konsert bor — boramizmi?

sentences.text: Builders are repairing the roof of **the school** during the holidays.
sentences.translation: Ta'til paytida quruvchilar **maktabning** tomini ta'mirlashyapti.

sentences.text: When I was at **university**, I shared a flat with three other students.
sentences.translation: **Talabalik** paytimda yana uch talaba bilan bitta kvartirada yashardim.

sentences.text: Is Jasur still at **school**, or has he finished? — He's in his last year.
sentences.translation: Jasur hali **maktabda o'qiyaptimi** yoki bitirdimi? — Oxirgi sinfda.

sentences.text: After **school**, the kids play football in the yard behind **the school** until their parents pick them up.
sentences.translation: **Darsdan keyin** bolalar ota-onalari olib ketguncha **maktab** orqasidagi hovlida futbol o'ynashadi.

examples.title: **in hospital** / **at the hospital**
examples.description: in hospital — bemor sifatida; at / to the hospital — ko'rgani borish, ishlash yoki bino haqida. go into / be taken to / come out of hospital — artiklsiz.

sentences.text: Grandpa has been **in hospital** since Monday with a chest infection.
sentences.translation: Bobom dushanbadan beri ko'krak infeksiyasi bilan **kasalxonada yotibdi**.

sentences.text: We went to **the hospital** to visit him after work.
sentences.translation: Ishdan keyin uni ko'rgani **kasalxonaga** bordik.

sentences.text: After the accident, the driver was taken to **hospital** with a broken leg.
sentences.translation: Avariyadan keyin haydovchi oyog'i singan holda **kasalxonaga** olib ketildi.

sentences.text: Madina works as a nurse at **the hospital** in the city centre.
sentences.translation: Madina shahar markazidagi **kasalxonada** hamshira bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: When is your uncle coming out of **hospital**? — Probably on Friday.
sentences.translation: Amakingiz **kasalxonadan** qachon chiqadi? — Ehtimol, juma kuni.

sentences.text: **The hospital** is building a new car park for visitors.
sentences.translation: **Kasalxona** tashrif buyuruvchilar uchun yangi avtoturargoh qurmoqda.

sentences.text: Emma had to go into **hospital** for a small operation on her knee.
sentences.translation: Emma tizzasidagi kichik operatsiya uchun **kasalxonaga yotishi** kerak bo'ldi.

sentences.text: I'm at **the hospital** now, but don't worry — it's just a routine check-up.
sentences.translation: Hozir **kasalxonadaman**, lekin xavotir olma — shunchaki navbatdagi tekshiruv.

sentences.text: Children who stay in **hospital** for a long time can continue their lessons online.
sentences.translation: **Kasalxonada** uzoq yotadigan bolalar darslarini onlayn davom ettirishi mumkin.

sentences.text: Nilufar spent two weeks in **hospital** last year, and **the hospital** staff were so kind that she sent them a cake.
sentences.translation: Nilufar o'tgan yili ikki hafta **kasalxonada yotdi**, **kasalxona** xodimlari shunchalik mehribon ekanki, u ularga tort yubordi.

examples.title: **prison** / **the prison**, **church** / **the church**
examples.description: go to / be in / be released from prison — mahbus sifatida; visit the prison — boshqa maqsadda. go to church — ibodat uchun; the church — bino.

sentences.text: The thief was sent to **prison** for three years.
sentences.translation: O'g'ri uch yilga **qamoqqa** hukm qilindi.

sentences.text: Journalists were allowed to visit **the prison** to see the conditions.
sentences.translation: Jurnalistlarga sharoitni ko'rish uchun **qamoqxonaga** kirishga ruxsat berildi.

sentences.text: He was released from **prison** after serving half of his sentence.
sentences.translation: U jazo muddatining yarmini o'tagach, **qamoqdan** ozod qilindi.

sentences.text: Kate's family goes to **church** every Sunday morning.
sentences.translation: Keytning oilasi har yakshanba ertalab **cherkovga** boradi.

sentences.text: We visited **the church** in the village because of its famous windows.
sentences.translation: Qishloqdagi **cherkovga** mashhur vitrajlarini ko'rish uchun kirib o'tdik.

sentences.text: The new guard was nervous on his first day at **the prison**.
sentences.translation: Yangi qorovul **qamoqxonadagi** birinchi kunida hayajonlangan edi.

sentences.text: If you drive like that, you'll end up in **prison**!
sentences.translation: Shunday haydasang, oxiri **qamalib** ketasan!

sentences.text: After **church**, Oliver's grandparents always have lunch with the whole family.
sentences.translation: **Cherkovdan keyin** Oliverning bobosi va buvisi doim butun oila bilan tushlik qilishadi.

sentences.text: **The church** was closed for repairs, so we could only see it from outside.
sentences.translation: **Cherkov** ta'mir uchun yopiq edi, shuning uchun uni faqat tashqaridan ko'ra oldik.

sentences.text: His lawyer visits **the prison** every week because she believes he went to **prison** for a crime he didn't commit.
sentences.translation: Advokati har hafta **qamoqxonaga** boradi, chunki u mijozini qilmagan jinoyati uchun **qamalgan** deb hisoblaydi.

examples.title: Article returns: **a** private school, **the** nearest hospital
examples.description: Sifat yoki aniqlovchi otni muayyan muassasaga aylantirsa, artikl qaytadi: a private school, the nearest hospital, the university where my father studied, my old school.

sentences.text: Their son goes to **a private school** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Ularning o'g'li Toshkentdagi **xususiy maktabda** o'qiydi.

sentences.text: Is there **a good hospital** in the town, or do we have to drive to Fergana?
sentences.translation: Shaharchada **yaxshi kasalxona** bormi yoki Farg'onaga borishimiz kerakmi?

sentences.text: **The university** where my father studied has become one of the best in the country.
sentences.translation: Otam o'qigan **universitet** mamlakatdagi eng yaxshilaridan biriga aylandi.

sentences.text: He spent ten years in **a high-security prison** in the north.
sentences.translation: U shimoldagi **qattiq tartibli qamoqxonada** o'n yil o'tirdi.

sentences.text: **My old school** has been turned into a library.
sentences.translation: **Eski maktabim** kutubxonaga aylantirildi.

sentences.text: Aziz applied to **a university** in Germany because the courses there are free.
sentences.translation: Aziz Germaniyadagi **bir universitetga** hujjat topshirdi, chunki u yerda o'qish bepul.

sentences.text: The ambulance took her to **the nearest hospital**, which was twenty kilometres away.
sentences.translation: Tez yordam uni yigirma kilometr naridagi **eng yaqin kasalxonaga** olib bordi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza teaches English at **a village school** near Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza Buxoro yaqinidagi **qishloq maktabida** ingliz tilidan dars beradi.

sentences.text: There's **a beautiful old church** on the hill above the village.
sentences.translation: Qishloq ustidagi tepalikda **chiroyli eski cherkov** bor.

sentences.text: My cousin wants to go to **university**, but she hasn't decided which **university** to apply to yet.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham **oliygohga kirmoqchi**, lekin hali qaysi **universitetga** hujjat topshirishni hal qilmagan.

examples.title: **bed**, **work**, **home**: go to bed / make **the** bed
examples.description: Faoliyat iboralari artiklsiz: go to bed, in bed; go to work, at work, finish work; go home, at home. Narsa yoki aniq vazifa haqida — the / a: make the bed, the work.

sentences.text: I was so tired that I went to **bed** at nine.
sentences.translation: Shunchalik charchagan edimki, soat to'qqizda **uxlagani yotdim**.

sentences.text: Don't sit on **the bed** with your shoes on!
sentences.translation: Oyoq kiyimingiz bilan **karavotga** o'tirmang!

sentences.text: Grandma has been in **bed** with flu all week.
sentences.translation: Buvim butun hafta gripp bo'lib **yotibdi**.

sentences.text: How long does it take you to get to **work** by metro?
sentences.translation: Metroda **ishga** yetib borishingiz qancha vaqt oladi?

sentences.text: Sarah can't answer personal calls at **work**, so send her a message.
sentences.translation: Sara **ishda** shaxsiy qo'ng'iroqlarga javob bera olmaydi, unga xabar yozing.

sentences.text: **The work** is interesting, but the pay is terrible.
sentences.translation: **Ishning o'zi** qiziq, lekin maoshi juda yomon.

sentences.text: Jasur finishes **work** at six and gets **home** at about seven.
sentences.translation: Jasur **ishni** oltida tugatadi va **uyga** taxminan yettida yetib keladi.

sentences.text: Every morning Madina makes **the bed** before she leaves for **work**.
sentences.translation: Madina har tong **ishga** ketishdan oldin **o'rnini yig'ishtiradi**.

sentences.text: We stayed at **home** last weekend because it was raining.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kunlari yomg'ir yog'gani uchun **uyda** qoldik.

sentences.text: Since the pandemic, many people work from **home** two days a week, and some never go back to **the office**.
sentences.translation: Pandemiyadan beri ko'p odamlar haftada ikki kun **uydan** ishlaydi, ayrimlari esa **ofisga** umuman qaytmadi.

examples.title: **in class**, **in court**, **in town**, **at sea**
examples.description: Boshqa faoliyat iboralari: in class / after class (dars), go to court / in court (sud), go into town / in town (shahar markazi), go to sea / at sea (dengizchilik). the bilan — guruh, bino yoki muayyan joy.

sentences.text: Please switch off your phones while you're in **class**.
sentences.translation: **Dars** paytida telefonlaringizni o'chiring, iltimos.

sentences.text: **The class** is too big — there are forty students and only one teacher.
sentences.translation: **Guruh** juda katta — qirqta talaba va bitta o'qituvchi.

sentences.text: Our company took its former manager to **court** for stealing customer data.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyamiz sobiq menejerini mijozlar ma'lumotlarini o'g'irlagani uchun **sudga berdi**.

sentences.text: Next month the case will be heard in **court**.
sentences.translation: Kelasi oy ish **sudda** ko'riladi.

sentences.text: I'm going into **town** to buy a present for Kate — do you need anything?
sentences.translation: Keytga sovg'a olgani **shaharga** boryapman — senga biror narsa kerakmi?

sentences.text: There aren't many good restaurants in **town**, so we usually eat at home.
sentences.translation: **Shaharda** yaxshi restoran kam, shuning uchun odatda uyda ovqatlanamiz.

sentences.text: **The town** where I was born has changed completely.
sentences.translation: Men tug'ilgan **shaharcha** butunlay o'zgarib ketgan.

sentences.text: My uncle went to **sea** at seventeen and later became a ship's captain.
sentences.translation: Amakim o'n yetti yoshida **dengizchilikka** ketgan, keyin kema kapitani bo'lgan.

sentences.text: Fishermen sometimes spend weeks at **sea** without seeing their families.
sentences.translation: Baliqchilar ba'zan oilalarini ko'rmasdan haftalab **dengizda** bo'lishadi.

sentences.text: After **class**, Bekzod and his friends often go into **town** for a coffee before taking the bus home.
sentences.translation: **Darsdan keyin** Bekzod va do'stlari uyga avtobusda qaytishdan oldin ko'pincha qahva ichgani **shaharga** borishadi.

examples.title: **home**: go home, leave home, **the** house
examples.description: home artiklsiz va harakat fe'llaridan keyin to siz: go / come / get home. leave home — ota-ona uyidan butunlay ketish; leave the house — uydan chiqish. Sifat bilan — a home.

sentences.text: It was after midnight when we finally got **home**.
sentences.translation: Nihoyat **uyga** yetib kelganimizda yarim tundan o'tgan edi.

sentences.text: Oliver left **home** at eighteen and moved to London to study.
sentences.translation: Oliver o'n sakkiz yoshida **ota-onasining uyidan ketib**, o'qish uchun Londonga ko'chdi.

sentences.text: I left **the house** at seven, but the traffic was terrible.
sentences.translation: **Uydan** yettida chiqdim, lekin tirbandlik dahshatli edi.

sentences.text: Call me when you're on your way **home**.
sentences.translation: **Uyga** qaytayotganingda menga qo'ng'iroq qil.

sentences.text: Is anybody **at home**? The lights are on, but nobody's answering.
sentences.translation: **Uyda** hech kim yo'qmi? Chiroqlar yoniq, lekin hech kim javob bermayapti.

sentences.text: They've made **a lovely home** for themselves in an old flat near the river.
sentences.translation: Ular daryo bo'yidagi eski kvartirada o'zlariga **shinam uy** yaratishdi.

sentences.text: We had dinner at **Aziz's house** and then walked **home** together.
sentences.translation: **Azizning uyida** kechki ovqat qildik, keyin birga **uyga** piyoda qaytdik.

sentences.text: My grandmother lives in **a care home**, and we visit her every Sunday.
sentences.translation: Buvim **qariyalar uyida** yashaydi, biz uni har yakshanba ko'rgani boramiz.

sentences.text: Make yourself **at home** — I'll put the kettle on.
sentences.translation: **O'z uyingizdagidek** bo'ling — choy qo'yaman.

sentences.text: **The house** we rented in Oxford was old and cold, but after a few months it really felt like **home**.
sentences.translation: Oksfordda ijaraga olgan **uyimiz** eski va sovuq edi, lekin bir necha oydan keyin u haqiqatan **o'z uyimizdek** bo'lib qoldi.

examples.title: Mixed: purpose or place?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: muassasa vazifasi (artiklsiz) va bino yoki muayyan joy (the / a) — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: My brother is still at **university**, but he works part-time in **the university** library.
sentences.translation: Akam hali **universitetda o'qiydi**, lekin **universitet** kutubxonasida yarim stavkada ishlaydi.

sentences.text: When Madina was in **hospital**, her colleagues came to **the hospital** with flowers every day.
sentences.translation: Madina **kasalxonada yotganida**, hamkasblari har kuni gul bilan **kasalxonaga** kelishardi.

sentences.text: Do you go to **church** regularly, or only at Christmas?
sentences.translation: **Cherkovga** muntazam borasizmi yoki faqat Rojdestvoda?

sentences.text: Parents' evening is at **the school** on Thursday, so I'll leave **work** early.
sentences.translation: Payshanba kuni **maktabda** ota-onalar majlisi bor, shuning uchun **ishdan** erta chiqaman.

sentences.text: Nobody was hurt, but the driver had to go to **court** and lost his licence.
sentences.translation: Hech kim jabrlanmadi, lekin haydovchi **sudda** javob berishi kerak bo'ldi va guvohnomasidan ayrildi.

sentences.text: Tom stayed in **bed** all morning because he'd worked a night shift.
sentences.translation: Tom tungi smenada ishlagani uchun ertalab bo'yi **to'shakda** yotdi.

sentences.text: The film was shot in **an old prison** that is now a hotel.
sentences.translation: Film hozir mehmonxonaga aylangan **eski qamoqxonada** suratga olingan.

sentences.text: Sarah left **school** at sixteen and went straight to **work** in a bakery.
sentences.translation: Sara o'n olti yoshida **maktabni** tugatdi va darhol novvoyxonada **ishlay** boshladi.

sentences.text: After the storm, the ship was lost at **sea** for three days.
sentences.translation: Bo'rondan keyin kema uch kun **dengizda** bedarak yo'qoldi.

sentences.text: Before he went to **prison**, he had been a teacher at **the same school** where his children now study.
sentences.translation: **Qamalishdan** oldin u hozir bolalari o'qiyotgan **o'sha maktabda** o'qituvchi bo'lgan.
